Card Q&A.a: If you attack with a Digimon that has this inherited effect while the effect is active, your opponent's Digimon can't change the target of the attack by blocking.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s inherited effect reads, “This Digimon can't be blocked.” How does this effect work, exactly?
I have a Digimon with [Imperialdramon] in its name and this card in its digivolution cards. Can it attack an opponent’s suspended Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If your Digimon has the "...can't be blocked" effect, your opponent's Digimon can't block or suspend to block.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent attacks with a Digimon with [Imperialdramon] in its name and this card in its digivolution cards. Even though I can't block it, can I still try to block with my Digimon with  just to suspend my Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If a Digimon card with [Free] in its traits is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, unsuspend this Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Imperialdramon] in its name, it can't be blocked.
